fields.Name: T194 - Admin ERD Select Entity Opens Details Panel
fields.Description: Exercises ERD node-selection → mj-entity-details side-panel wiring (onNodeClick → selectedEntity → Fields/Related accordions) — distinct from the generic grid row-click/record-preview path.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) viewer. Wait for the diagram to render (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). Click on any entity card/node in the diagram. Success is that selecting a node opens the entity details panel on the RIGHT side, showing that entity's name, its Schema and Table, and collapsible accordion sections labeled 'Fields (N)' and 'Related Entities (N)'. Expand the Fields section if it is not already open. Seeing the details panel with the Fields section render is success — you do NOT need to open the entity's records.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking an entity node selects it and opens a right-side details panel showing Schema/Table for that entity
The details panel shows accordion sections for Fields and Related Entities, with the Fields list rendering when expanded
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
